HISD Tooltip

A transient label surfaced on hover or keyboard focus. Wired to its trigger via aria-describedby; it never acts as the sole label (icon-only triggers carry aria-label). Shown on mouseenter / focus-visible after a 300 ms delay; hidden immediately on mouseleave / blur / Escape. Both panels render the same markup — the right one is nested under data-theme="dark".

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Wrapper provides the positioning context -->
<span class="hisd-tooltip">
  <button type="button"
          class="hisd-tooltip__trigger"
          aria-describedby="tt-save">
    Save
  </button>
  <span role="tooltip"
        id="tt-save"
        class="hisd-tooltip__bubble hisd-tooltip__bubble--top">
    Saves your changes to the campus record
  </span>
</span>

<!-- Icon-only trigger: aria-label names it, tooltip describes it -->
<span class="hisd-tooltip">
  <button type="button"
          class="hisd-tooltip__trigger hisd-tooltip__trigger--icon"
          aria-label="Help"
          aria-describedby="tt-help">
    <svg class="hisd-tooltip__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <path d="M12 2a10 10 0 1 0 0 20 10 10 0 0 0 0-20Z…"/>
    </svg>
  </button>
  <span role="tooltip" id="tt-help" class="hisd-tooltip__bubble hisd-tooltip__bubble--top">
    Read the enrollment guide
  </span>
</span>

Placement modifiers: --top (default), --bottom, --start, --end. Hover and focus work with CSS alone; the script below adds the WAI-ARIA APG behaviors (focus shows, Escape hides, and re-focus after Escape stays dismissed).
